articles.abstract: Anaesthetic endpoints such as immobility and unconsciousness are defined at the population level through metrics such as minimal alveolar concentration (MAC) and MAC-awake, yet how individuals behave at those concentrations remains poorly understood. In a recent study in the British Journal of Anaesthesia, Mandel and colleagues address this by characterising the behavioural dynamics of mice held at fixed concentrations of isoflurane corresponding to either population MAC or MAC-awake, and tracking whether they right themselves or respond to a paw pinch across repeated testing. Both endpoints flip states unpredictably yet resist switching and, interestingly, are wholly independent of one another.

articles.title: 儿科麻醉后监护病房中恢复质量与出院准备度评估工具的评价
articles.originalTitle: Measures of Quality of Recovery and Discharge-readiness Tools in the Pediatric Postanesthesia Care Unit.
articles.abstract: The postanesthesia care unit is a critical phase of recovery, yet routine assessment often focuses on discharge readiness rather than the child's recovery experience. This study reviewed measures used in pediatric postanesthesia care unit pathways to assess discharge readiness and early recovery quality and synthesized how they capture domains that matter to children, families, and clinicians. This is a structured literature review with narrative synthesis and identified eight tools used in children: Steward score, Modified Aldrete Score, physiologic criteria-based score, White and Song fast-track score, Criteria for Fast-Tracking Children, Pediatric Post-Anesthetic Discharge Scoring System, Pediatric Readiness for Discharge Instrument, and Discerning Post Anesthesia Readiness for Transition. These tools varied by intended phase and destination, with consistent coverage of consciousness, oxygenation, and hemodynamics but variable assessment of the airway, pain, nausea and vomiting, bleeding, and function. A postanesthesia care unit-specific pediatric quality-of-recovery measure remains a key research and quality improvement gap.

sections.text: 麻醉后监护病房是恢复的关键阶段，然而常规评估往往侧重于出院准备情况，而非儿童的恢复体验。本研究回顾了儿科麻醉后监护病房路径中用于评估出院准备情况和早期恢复质量的测量工具，并综合了它们如何捕捉对儿童、家庭和临床医生重要的领域。这是一项采用叙述性综合的结构化文献综述，确定了用于儿童的八种工具：Steward评分、改良Aldrete评分、基于生理标准的评分、White和Song快速通道评分、儿童快速通道标准、儿科麻醉后出院评分系统、儿科出院准备工具和辨别麻醉后过渡准备情况。这些工具在预期阶段和目的地方面有所不同，对意识、氧合和血流动力学的覆盖一致，但对气道、疼痛、恶心呕吐、出血和功能的评估各不相同。针对麻醉后监护病房的儿科恢复质量测量工具仍然是一个关键的研究和质量改进空白。

articles.title: 小儿斜视手术中神经肌肉阻滞深度与眼心反射：一项随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Neuromuscular Blockade Depth and Oculocardiac Reflex in Pediatric Strabismus Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Although neuromuscular blockade reduces oculocardiac reflex (OCR) incidence compared with no neuromuscular blockade, the effect of blockade depth on OCR has not been prospectively evaluated. This study aimed to evaluate whether the depth of neuromuscular blockade influences the incidence of the OCR during pediatric strabismus surgery. METHODS: In this prospective, double-blinded randomized controlled trial, 204 pediatric patients aged 3 to 18 years undergoing strabismus surgery under general anesthesia were randomly assigned to moderate-to-deep neuromuscular blockade (MD-NMB; train-of-four count 0-3) or minimal-to-shallow neuromuscular blockade (MS-NMB; train-of-four count 4 with ratio <0.9). The primary outcome was the incidence of OCR grade >/=2, defined as a >/=20% decrease in heart rate from baseline. Secondary outcomes included severe OCR (grade >/=3, defined as a >/=30% decrease in heart rate), as well as the magnitude and duration of heart rate reduction. RESULTS: A total of 201 patients were analyzed (MS-NMB, n=102; MD-NMB, n=99). The incidence of OCR grade >/=2 was lower in the MD-NMB group compared with the MS-NMB group (30.3% vs. 53.9%; odds ratio [OR] 0.37; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.21-0.66; p = 0.001). OCR grade >/=3 was also reduced in the MD-NMB group (18.2% vs. 35.3%; OR 0.41, 95% CI 0.21-0.78; p = 0.007). Among patients who developed OCR, the magnitude (34.3% [26.9-42.6%] vs. 28.0% [18.2-35.9%]; p=0.003) and duration (46.0s [30.3-65.8s] vs. 37.0s [17.0-49.5s]; p=0.024) of heart rate reduction were smaller in the MD-NMB group. CONCLUSIONS: Moderate to deep neuromuscular blockade significantly reduced both the incidence and severity of OCR during pediatric strabismus surgery compared with minimal to shallow blockade. These findings suggest that deeper neuromuscular blockade may represent an effective strategy to attenuate OCR during extraocular muscle manipulation.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 尽管与不使用神经肌肉阻滞相比，神经肌肉阻滞可降低眼心反射（OCR）的发生率，但阻滞深度对OCR的影响尚未进行前瞻性评估。本研究旨在评估神经肌肉阻滞深度是否影响小儿斜视手术中OCR的发生率。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在这项前瞻性、双盲随机对照试验中，204名年龄在3至18岁、在全身麻醉下接受斜视手术的儿科患者被随机分配至中度至深度神经肌肉阻滞组（MD-NMB；四个成串刺激计数0-3）或轻度至浅度神经肌肉阻滞组（MS-NMB；四个成串刺激计数4且比值<0.9）。主要结局是OCR等级≥2的发生率，定义为心率较基线下降≥20%。次要结局包括严重OCR（等级≥3，定义为心率下降≥30%），以及心率降低的幅度和持续时间。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 与轻度至浅度阻滞相比，中度至深度神经肌肉阻滞显著降低了小儿斜视手术中OCR的发生率和严重程度。这些发现提示，在眼外肌操作期间，更深的神经肌肉阻滞可能代表一种减轻OCR的有效策略。

articles.title: 冷冻神经松解术热曲线：超声引导经皮热电偶的体内描述性数据
articles.originalTitle: Cryoneurolysis Thermal Graphs: In Vivo Descriptive Data from Ultrasound-guided Percutaneous Thermocouples.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cryoneurolysis provides analgesia by reversibly ablating peripheral nerves using gas-induced exceptionally low temperature. The desired therapeutic temperature is between approximately -20 degrees C and -100 degrees C. Warmer temperatures can induce a neuropraxia that may itself induce pain; and colder temperatures can result in permanent nerve injury. Therefore, it is imperative that the target nerve reach but not exceed the therapeutic window. METHODS: A convenience sample of participants undergoing mastectomy (n = 3) received a high-thoracic paravertebral nerve block, while subjects being treated for traumatic rib fractures (n = 3) did not. All participants had ultrasound-guided cryoneurolysis of multiple intercostal nerves with a percutaneous thermocouple inserted approximately 3 mm adjacent to the cryoprobe shaft. The returning argon gas and tissue temperatures were correlated. Due to the limited sample size, the data are presented and not statistically analyzed. RESULTS: Although in all cases (31 nerves) the returning gas was ultimately colder than -80 degrees C, the tissue adjacent to the probe did not reach -20 degrees C after 3 and 5 min in 71% (n = 5) and 42% (n = 10) of treatments, respectively. The coldest mean temperature in adjacent tissue was 60 degrees C warmer than the returning gas with out a nerve block, and 95 degrees C warmer with a concurrent nerve block. When treating adjacent intercostal nerves, the gas temperature remained unchanged, while the tissue became colder with each consecutive treatment. CONCLUSIONS: During percutaneous cryoneurolysis, the temperature of tissue is frequently deceptively warm relative to the returning gas and tissue frequently does not reach an adequately cold temperature; prolonging gas treatment from 3 to 5 min improves the success of reaching therapeutic temperatures; the presence of a peripheral nerve block appears to lessen the chance of reaching therapeutic temperatures; and caution is warranted when treating consecutive intercostal nerves as tissue temperature may decrease with each level.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 冷冻神经松解术通过使用气体诱导的极低温度可逆性地消融周围神经来提供镇痛。理想的治疗温度大约在-20摄氏度至-100摄氏度之间。较暖的温度可诱发神经失用症，其本身可能引起疼痛；而较冷的温度可能导致永久性神经损伤。因此，靶神经必须达到但不能超过治疗窗口至关重要。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 一项便利样本中，接受乳房切除术的参与者（n=3）接受了高位胸椎旁神经阻滞，而因创伤性肋骨骨折接受治疗的受试者（n=3）未接受阻滞。所有参与者均在超声引导下对多条肋间神经进行冷冻神经松解术，经皮热电偶插入距冷冻探针杆约3毫米处。回流的氩气和组织温度被关联。由于样本量有限，数据仅呈现而未进行统计分析。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 尽管在所有病例（31条神经）中，回流气体最终低于-80摄氏度，但在3分钟和5分钟时，探针旁组织分别有71%（n=5）和42%（n=10）的治疗未达到-20摄氏度。无神经阻滞时，邻近组织的最低平均温度比回流气体高60摄氏度；有并发神经阻滞时，则高95摄氏度。在治疗相邻肋间神经时，气体温度保持不变，而组织温度随着每次连续治疗而变得更冷。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在经皮冷冻神经松解术中，组织温度相对于回流气体常常具有欺骗性的温暖，且组织经常无法达到足够冷的温度；将气体治疗时间从3分钟延长至5分钟可提高达到治疗温度的成功率；存在周围神经阻滞似乎降低了达到治疗温度的机会；在治疗连续肋间神经时应谨慎，因为组织温度可能随每个节段而降低。

articles.title: 麻醉工作站在小儿通气中的性能：第2部分——压力支持通气期间的特征与氧浓度上升时间
articles.originalTitle: Anesthesia Workstation Performance in Pediatric Ventilation: Part 2. Characteristics during Pressure Support Ventilation and Oxygen Rise Times.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Modern anesthesia workstations include various ventilator technologies, but the effects on pediatric ventilation are unclear. The hypothesis of this study was that performance during pressure support ventilation and times to increase oxygen concentrations depend on the type of anesthesia workstation. METHODS: Six modern anesthesia workstations (GE HealthCare Carestation 650; Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics Co. Ltd. Wato EX-65 Pro and A9; Drager Medical Atlan A350 and Perseus A500; and Getinge Flow-c) were evaluated in respiratory models of a preterm baby, a neonate, an infant, and a toddler. Trigger response rates, trigger delay, and time to reach 50% of peak inspiratory pressure during pressure support ventilation were compared. Furthermore, the times required to increase oxygen concentration from 21 to 90% during pressure-controlled ventilation at fresh gas flows of 1, 3, and 10 l . min -1 were assessed in a compartment of the lung models with the volume corresponding to the respective model's functional residual capacity. RESULTS: Trigger response rates were above 90%, with few exceptions. Trigger delays ranged between 73 +/- 6 and 145 +/- 0 ms. Times to reach 50% peak pressure ranged between 161 +/- 1 and 312 +/- 1 ms, with decreasing variability in the larger patient models. Oxygen rise time varied between 94 +/- 3 and 615 +/- 60 s at the lowest fresh gas flow and decreased with increasing fresh gas flow to 3 l . min -1 and less so with further increasing fresh gas flow to 10 l . min -1 . Activation of oxygen flush did not generally increase oxygen concentration but caused relevant airway pressure increases in some devices. CONCLUSIONS: Modern anesthesia workstations show an overall good performance during pressure support ventilation of children. During pressure-controlled ventilation, a moderate increase of fresh gas flow accelerated the rise in oxygen concentration, depending on the device. Oxygen flush brings no advantage in this regard but may put the patient at risk of high airway pressure.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 现代麻醉工作站包含多种呼吸机技术，但其对儿科通气的影响尚不清楚。本研究的假设是，在压力支持通气期间的表现以及增加氧浓度的时间取决于麻醉工作站的类型。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在早产儿、新生儿、婴儿和幼儿的呼吸模型中评估了六种现代麻醉工作站（GE HealthCare Carestation 650；迈瑞生物医疗电子有限公司 Wato EX-65 Pro 和 A9；德尔格医疗 Atlan A350 和 Perseus A500；以及 Getinge Flow-c）。比较了压力支持通气期间的触发响应率、触发延迟以及达到吸气峰压50%的时间。此外，在肺模型的一个隔室中，其容积对应于相应模型的功能残气量，评估了在新鲜气体流量为1、3和10升/分钟的压力控制通气期间，氧浓度从21%增加到90%所需的时间。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 触发响应率高于90%，仅有少数例外。触发延迟范围为73±6至145±0毫秒。达到50%峰压的时间范围为161±1至312±1毫秒，在较大的患者模型中变异性减小。在最低新鲜气体流量下，氧上升时间在94±3至615±60秒之间变化，并随着新鲜气体流量增加到3升/分钟而减少，进一步增加到10升/分钟时减少程度较小。氧冲洗的激活通常不会增加氧浓度，但在某些设备中会导致气道压力显著升高。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 现代麻醉工作站在小儿压力支持通气期间表现出整体良好的性能。在压力控制通气期间，适度增加新鲜气体流量可加速氧浓度的上升，具体取决于设备。氧冲洗在这方面没有优势，但可能使患者面临高气道压力的风险。

articles.question: 小儿麻醉中，通气支持的质量和氧浓度调整速度直接影响患儿安全。不同麻醉工作站的性能差异可能影响通气效果和氧合管理，了解这些差异有助于临床设备选择和使用优化。
articles.conclusion: 现代麻醉工作站在小儿压力支持通气中总体表现良好，但氧浓度上升时间受新鲜气体流量和设备类型影响，且氧冲洗可能增加气道压力风险。
articles.clinical: 现代麻醉工作站在小儿压力支持通气中总体表现良好，但不同设备在触发延迟和压力上升时间上存在差异，可能影响通气同步性和患者舒适度。 在压力控制通气中，适度增加新鲜气体流量（如从1 L/min增至3 L/min）可加速氧浓度上升，但进一步增加至10 L/min获益有限，临床可根据设备特性优化流量设置。 氧冲洗并不增加氧浓度，反而可能引起气道压力升高，应谨慎使用，尤其在儿科患者中。
